name: Iwakura Aria
source:
[i]Iwakura Aria[/i] is a brand-new original visual novel from MAGES. It is a dramatic suspense title that depicts the love-and-hate pattern of human relationships and the strong bonds between women. It is a suspenseful human drama set in Japan during a period of rapid economic growth. The rich story, which follows the complex and sometimes contradictory emotions of each character, and the turbulent developments brought about by their emotions, invites players back to “that summer” of 1966.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2024/02/mages-announces-suspense-visual-novel-iwakura-aria-for-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
[i]Iwakura Aria[/i] 是MAGES的全新原创视觉小说。这是一部戏剧性的悬疑片，描绘了人际关系的爱恨情仇和女性之间的牢固纽带。这是一部以经济高速增长时期的日本为背景的悬疑人情剧​​。丰富的故事情节，讲述了每个角色复杂且时而矛盾的情感，以及情感带来的动荡发展，将玩家带回到1966年的“那个夏天”。

[来自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2024/02/mages-announces-suspense-visual-novel-iwakura-aria-for-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
